mt: Har state code ke liye, state code, household ID ka total count, aur average household split number list karo.

src: Rank the months of 2022 from highest to lowest based on the total number of allopathic outpatient visits.
mt: 2022 ke months ko allopathic outpatient visits ke total number ke basis par highest se lowest tak rank karo.

src: Identify the rural sub-districts that had maternal ANC registrations in 2022 but did not record any in 2021.
mt: 2022 mein maternal ANC registrations wale rural sub-districts dhundho, lekin 2021 mein koi record na ho.

src: Identify the top 10 districts with the highest average chickpea yield recorded in 1970.
mt: Top 10 districts dhundho jahan 1970 mein sabse zyada average chickpea yield record hua ho.

src: Provide the number of animal care workers and the Gauna dates for all Christian households.
mt: Christian households ke liye animal care workers ki sankhya aur Gauna dates provide karo.

src: Compare the average monthly non-food spending and per capita consumption between urban and rural areas, sorted by the highest non-food expenditure.
mt: Urban aur rural areas ke beech average monthly non-food spending aur per capita consumption ka comparison karo, highest non-food expenditure ke hisaab se sort karte hue.

src: Which rural sub-districts reported more than 500 pregnant women with hemoglobin levels below 11 in the year 2021?
mt: Kaun se gaon ke ilaake mein 2021 mein 11 se kam hemoglobin wale 500 se zyada pregnant women report kiye gaye?

src: List the monthly non-food expenditure and the number of workers for the top 10 rural households in Uttar Pradesh with the highest spending.
mt: Uttar Pradesh ke top 10 rural households ke liye, jo sabse zyada kharch karte hain, monthly non-food expenditure aur workers ki ginti list karo.

src: Provide the number of animal care workers and the Gauna dates for Christian households.
mt: Christian households ke liye animal care workers ki sankhya aur Gauna dates provide karo.

src: Identify the states where the maximum monthly non-food expenditure for urban households does not exceed 5,000 rupees.
mt: States identify karo jahan par urban households ka maximum monthly non-food expenditure 5,000 rupees se zyada na ho.

src: Provide a breakdown of total allopathic outpatient attendance and BCG vaccinations for each urban sub-district, sorted by the highest attendance volume.
mt: Har sub urban sub-district ke liye, total allopathic outpatient attendance aur BCG vaccinations ka breakdown do, jisme highest attendance volume ke hisaab se sort kiya ho.

src: Show the education at migration codes and the total count of migrants for those whose activity status is 'Salaried' and whose married when migrated indicator is not null, grouped by their education at migration code and ordered by the count in descending order for the top 5 results.
mt: Un migration codes ki education aur total count of migrants dikhao jinka activity status 'Salaried' hai aur married when migrated indicator null nahi hai, inhein education at migration code ke basis pe group karo aur count ke hisaab se descending order mein top 5 results show karo.

src: Which sub-districts have recorded more than 5,000 allopathic outpatient visits and over 1,000 BCG vaccinations?
mt: Kaunse sub-districts mein 5,000 se zyada allopathic outpatient visits aur 1,000 se adhik BCG vaccinations record hui hain?

src: Provide the pearl millet yields for districts in Chhattisgarh between 1966 and 1970, ordered chronologically.
mt: Chhattisgarh ke districts mein 1966 se 1970 tak pearl millet yields pata karo, chronological order mein arrange karke.

src: Which sub-districts distributed combined oral pill cycles but did not distribute any condoms during the year 2022?
mt: Kaunse sub-districts ne 2022 mein combined oral pill cycles distribute kiye, lekin condoms ek bhi nahi baate?

src: List the sub-district names, ordered alphabetically, for areas where the estimated finance from government assistance is 0.000 and the estimated finance borrowed from institutions is also 0.000.
mt: Un sub-district names ki list banao, alphabetical order mein, jahan government assistance se estimated finance 0.000 ho aur institutions se borrowed estimated finance bhi 0.000 ho.

src: Rank the sub-districts and their area types by the total number of allopathic outpatient visits recorded throughout 2021, starting with the highest attendance.
mt: Sub-districts aur unke area types ko 2021 ke allopathic outpatient visits ke total number se rank karo, highest attendance se start karte hue.

src: Which rural sub-districts reported at least some administration of the first Vitamin A dose during the year 2022?
mt: Kaunse rural sub-districts ne year 2022 mein Vitamin A ki pehli dose ki administration report ki thi, chahe thodi hi kyun na ho?

src: For the most recent census year available, list the sub-district names along with the total estimated transport and storage costs and the total estimated accommodation and food costs, grouped by sub-district and ordered by the total estimated transport and storage costs in descending order.
mt: Sabse recent census year jo available hai, uske liye sub-district ke naam list karo, jismein total estimated transport and storage costs aur total estimated accommodation and food costs ke saath, sub-district ke hisaab se group karke, aur total estimated transport and storage costs ke descending order mein arrange karo.

src: For the census year 2013, list each sub-district name along with the total estimated transport and storage costs and the total estimated accommodation and food costs, grouped and ordered alphabetically by the sub-district name.
mt: Census year 2013 ke liye, har sub-district ka naam list karo, saath mein total estimated transport and storage costs aur total estimated accommodation and food costs. Sub-district name ke hisaab se group karo aur alphabetical order mein arrange karo.

src: List the unique PSU codes in ascending order for households where the completion status is 'Located', the household split number is 0, and the new household split number is 1.
mt: Un households ke liye unique PSU codes ascending order mein list karo jahan completion status 'Located' hai, household split number 0 hai, aur new household split number 1 hai.

src: For the state of 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' during the 1991 census year, list each district and its calculated household density—defined as the total number of households divided by the total number of occupied residential houses—ensuring the total occupied residential houses is greater than zero, and show the top 10 districts with the highest density.
mt: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye 1991 census year mein, har district aur uski calculated household density list karo—jisme household density ko total households divided by total occupied residential houses define kiya gaya hai—ensure karo ki total occupied residential houses zero se zyada ho, aur top 10 districts with highest density dikhao.

src: List the sub-district names for areas where the rural population is greater than 1109.000 or the scheduled tribes rural population is greater than 0.000.
mt: Un sub-district names ki list dikhao jahan rural population 1109.000 se zyada ho ya scheduled tribes rural population 0.000 se zyada ho.

src: For the districts of 'North And Middle Andaman' and 'South Andamans', list each district name and the total sum of registered private medical practitioners and community health workers combined.
mt: 'North And Middle Andaman' aur 'South Andamans' districts ke liye, har district name aur registered private medical practitioners aur community health workers ka total sum list karo.

src: For the year 1970, provide a state-wise breakdown of the average yields for rice and maize, sorted alphabetically by state name.
mt: 1970 ke liye, state-wise breakdown dena hai rice aur maize ke average yields ka, alphabetical order mein state name ke basis par sorted.

src: For accidents that occurred on a Friday, list each area where an accident occurred along with the average number of casualties and the total count of accident IDs for each of those areas.
mt: Joh accidents Friday ko hua hain, unke liye har area ke liye list karo jahan accident hua tha, saath mein average number of casualties aur har area ke liye total count of accident IDs.

src: Identify all districts that either are classified as urban areas or have conducted household re-interviews.
mt: Sare districts ko identify karo jo urban areas mein classified hai ya fir household re-interviews conduct kiye hain.

src: Provide a state-wise summary of the average yields and total production for pearl and finger millets between 1966 and 1970.
mt: 1966 se 1970 ke beech, har state ka pearl aur finger millets ke average yields aur total production ka summary provide karo.

src: Which five rural sub-districts recorded the highest total allopathic outpatient attendance during the year 2021?
mt: Konsa paanch gaon ke ilaake ne saal 2021 mein sabse zyada allopathic outpatient attendance record kiya hai?

src: List the light conditions and the weather conditions for each unique combination of these two factors that is associated with at least one accident.
mt: Har ek unique combination ke liye light conditions aur weather conditions list karo jo light aur weather dono factors ke liye associated hai, aur jisme at least ek accident ho.

src: For each occupation description, what is the average number of years since death and the total count of deceased IDs?
mt: Har ek occupation description ke liye, death ke baad se average number of years aur deceased IDs ka total count kya hai?

src: Which districts produced both pearl millet and more than 200 tons of finger millet in 1970?
mt: १९७० मध्ये कोणत्या जिल्ह्यांनी बाजरी आणि २०० टनांपेक्षा जास्त नाचणी उत्पादन केली?

src: List the household IDs and their corresponding caste or religious group categories, ordered from highest to lowest household asset index.
mt: Household IDs aur unke caste ya religious group categories ko list karo, highest se lowest household asset index ke order mein.

src: For the state of 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' and the census year 1991, list each district and the total number of female main workers who are agricultural labourers, sorted by the total number of these workers in descending order.
mt: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state aur 1991 census year ke liye, har district ko list karo aur total female main workers joh agricultural labourers hain, unka total number descending order mein sort karke.

src: List the location name, state, and district for areas where the number of households exceeds the number of occupied residential houses, ordered by the number of households from highest to lowest.
mt: Location name, state, aur district list karein jahan households ki sankhya occupied residential houses se zyada ho, aur households ki sankhya ke hisaab se highest to lowest order mein arrange karein.

src: For the state of 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' during the 1991 census year, list each district along with the total number of occupied residential houses and the total number of male workers in trade and commerce, ordered from highest to lowest by the total number of occupied residential houses.
mt: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye, 1991 census year mein, har district ko list karo jisme occupied residential houses ki total sankhya aur trade and commerce mein male workers ki total sankhya ho, aur order karo occupied residential houses ki total sankhya ke hisaab se sabse zyada se sabse kam.

src: For the census year 2013, list the ULB RLB village names where the estimated human health and social work value is greater than 50.
mt: Census year 2013 ke liye, un ULB RLB village names ki list banao jahan estimated human health and social work value 50 se zyada hai.

src: Provide a yearly breakdown by state of the total number of Vitamin A first doses and Measles-Rubella (MCV 1st dose) administered to infants aged 9 to 11 months, sorted chronologically.
mt: Har saal ke hisaab se, state-wise breakdown do, jismein 9 se 11 mahine ke bacchon ko di gayi Vitamin A ki pehli dose aur Measles-Rubella (MCV 1st dose) ki total count ho, chronological order mein sorted.

src: For the census year 2013, list the ULB RLB village names and their corresponding sub-district names, specifically for locations where the sum of estimated education values is at least 1.000 and the sum of estimated human health and social values is at least 1.000, ordered alphabetically by sub-district name.
mt: Census year 2013 ke liye, ULB RLB village names aur unke corresponding sub-district names list karo, specifically un locations ke liye jahan sum of estimated education values kam se kam 1.000 ho aur sum of estimated human health and social values bhi kam se kam 1.000 ho. Results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.

src: Which states have at least one district with recorded household data for Dalit communities?
mt: Konsi states mein aisa kam se kam ek district hai jahan Dalit communities ke liye recorded household data available hai?

src: Provide a list of all unique reason descriptions from the migration reasons dimension.
mt: migration reasons dimension se saare unique reason descriptions ki list provide karein.

src: Rank the urban sub-districts by their allopathic outpatient attendance for the year 2022, starting with the highest.
mt: Urban sub-districts ko 2022 ke allopathic outpatient attendance ke hisaab se rank karo, sabse zyada se shuru karte hue.

src: Provide the household ID, asset index, and secondary social network contact type for all households belonging to the OBC category.
mt: Sabhi OBC category ke households ke liye household ID, asset index, aur secondary social network contact type provide karo.

src: Identify the IDs of geographic areas where there is at least one re-interviewed household containing three or more youths aged 15 to 21, sorted numerically.
mt: Geographic areas ke IDs pata karo jahan kam se kam ek aisa ghar ho jo re-interview hua ho aur jisme teen ya usse zyada yuva hon, umar 15 se 21 ke beech, aur results ko numerically sort karo.

src: List the household ID and the new household split number for all records where the household status ID is 1 and the same address indicator is 'Yes'.
mt: ज्या सर्व नोंदींसाठी 'household status ID' १ आहे आणि 'same address indicator' 'Yes' आहे, अशा सर्व नोंदींसाठी 'household ID' आणि 'new household split number' ची यादी करा.

src: For the census year 2013, list the sub-district names and the names of the ULB, RLB, or villages where the total estimated manufacturing in the secondary sector is greater than 50, ordered from highest to lowest total estimated manufacturing.
mt: Census year 2013 ke liye, sub-district names aur un ULB, RLB ya villages ke names dikhao jahan secondary sector mein total estimated manufacturing 50 se zyada hai, aur results ko highest se lowest total estimated manufacturing ke hisaab se order karo.

src: List the districts where the census year is 1991 and there are female main workers recorded as agricultural labourers, specifically filtering for districts where the total sum of female main workers who are agricultural labourers exceeds 5000, ordered from highest to lowest sum.
mt: Dikha do un districts ko jahan census year 1991 hai aur female main workers jo agricultural labourers hain unka record hai, specifically un districts ko filter karo jahan female main workers jo agricultural labourers hain unka total sum 5000 se zyada hai, aur order karo highest sum se lowest sum tak.

src: List the sub-district names for areas where the number of subsidized medical practitioners is at least 0.000 and the number of community health workers is exactly 0.000.
mt: Un sub-district names ki list dikhao jahan subsidized medical practitioners ka number kam se kam 0.000 ho aur community health workers ka number exactly 0.000 ho.

src: For each age band of the driver, list the age band, the average number of casualties, and the total count of accident IDs, filtering for groups where the average number of casualties is greater than one and ordering the results by the accident count in descending order.
mt: Driver ke har age band ke liye, age band ko list karo, average number of casualties ko, aur total count of accident IDs ko, filtering karte hue un groups ke liye jahan average number of casualties ek se zyada ho, aur results ko accident count ke basis par descending order mein arrange karo.

src: For the year 2021 in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, provide a sub-district breakdown of planned and conducted immunization sessions, along with the distribution totals for oral pills and condoms, for areas that had at least one session planned. Sort the results by the number of sessions held.
mt: 2021 ke liye, Andaman aur Nicobar Islands mein, un sub-districts ka breakdown do jahan ek bhi immunization session plan kiya gaya ho. Planned aur conducted immunization sessions ke saath, oral pills aur condoms ke distribution totals bhi batayein. Results ko sessions held ki sankhya ke hisaab se sort karo.

src: Rank the states by the average number of children aged 0 to 14 per household, including only those states with more than one recorded household.
mt: States ko ranking karo average number of children aged 0 to 14 per household ke basis par, sirf un states ko include karte hue jahan ek se zyada recorded households hain.

src: List the casualty class and the total count of bridge accident casualty IDs for records where the casualty severity is 2, specifically filtering for and showing only the 'Pedestrian' casualty class, ordered by the casualty class.
mt: Casualty class aur bridge accident casualty IDs ka total count dikhao un records ke liye jahan casualty severity 2 hai, aur sirf 'Pedestrian' casualty class ke liye filter karke results dikhao, casualty class ke hisaab se order karke.

src: Provide the annual sunflower cultivation statistics, including area, production, and yield, for all districts in Chhattisgarh, ordered chronologically.
mt: Chhattisgarh ke sabhi districts ke liye, annual sunflower cultivation ke statistics provide karo, jisme area, production, aur yield shamil ho, chronologically order karke.

src: For each district where the number of households exceeds the number of occupied residential houses, list the district name along with the total number of male main workers in mining and quarrying and the total number of female main workers in mining and quarrying, ensuring at least one record exists per district and ordering the results by the total male workers in mining and quarrying in descending order.
mt: Har district ke liye jahan households ki sankhya occupied residential houses se zyada ho, district name ke saath mining and quarrying mein total male main workers aur total female main workers ki sankhya list karo, yeh ensure karte hue ki kam se kam ek record per district ho aur results ko mining and quarrying mein total male workers ke hisaab se descending order mein arrange karo.

src: For each age band of the driver, list the age band itself, the average number of casualties, and the total count of accident IDs.
mt: प्रत्येक वयोगटासाठी, वयोगट स्वतः, सरासरी जखमींची संख्या, आणि अपघातांच्या आयडीची एकूण संख्या सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: Rank the sub-districts and their area types by the total number of allopathic outpatient visits recorded throughout 2021, starting with the highest attendance.
mt: Sub-districts aur unke area types ko 2021 ke saal bhar record kiye gaye allopathic outpatient visits ke total number ke hisaab se rank karo, highest attendance se shuru karte hue.

src: Provide a breakdown of household counts by asset index and social group for families that are both engaged in business activities and currently carry outstanding loans.
mt: Business activities mein lage hue aur abhi tak ke loans wale families ke liye, asset index aur social group ke hisaab se gharo ki sankhya ka breakdown do.

src: For the census year 2013, list each sub-district name and the total sum of establishments where the residential or commercial status is 0.000, including only those sub-districts with a total sum greater than 0.000, and sort the results by the sum of establishments in descending order.
mt: 2013 च्या जनगणना वर्षासाठी, निवासी किंवा व्यावसायिक स्थिती 0.000 असलेल्या प्रतिष्ठानांची एकूण बेरीज 0.000 पेक्षा जास्त असलेल्या उपजिल्ह्यांची यादी करा, आणि परिणाम प्रतिष्ठानांच्या बेरीच्या उतरत्या क्रमाने लावा.

src: Identify the sub-districts that have recorded allopathic outpatient attendance but have not reported any BCG vaccinations.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठी भाषेत भाषांतर करा:
सर्व अलोपथिक आउटपेशंट उपस्थिती नोंदवलेले ते उप-जिल्हे ओळखा ज्यांनी कोणतेही बीसीजी लसीकरण अहवालित केले नाही.

src: Rank the states by their average monthly per capita consumption for households that are above the poverty line.
mt: போர் வரியை மேலே உள்ள வீட்டுகளுக்கு அவர்களின் சராசரி மாதாந்திர தனிநபர் பயன்பாட்டை அடிப்படையில் மாநிலங்களை வரிசைப்படுத்துங்கள்.

src: Which districts produced both pearl millet and more than 200 tons of finger millet in 1970?
mt: কোন জেলাগুলো ১৯৭০ সালে মুক্তা বাজরা এবং ২০০ টনের বেশি নাচনি বাজরা উৎপাদন করেছিল?

src: List the casualty IDs for casualties classified as pedestrians where the casualty severity level is 2.
mt: కాసువల్టీ సెవెరిటీ లెవల్ 2 ఉన్న పెడెస్ట్రియన్‌లుగా వర్గీకరించిన కాసువల్టీల కోసం కాసువల్టీ IDలను జాబితా చేయండి.

src: List the district codes for the top 10 districts that have a count of household split numbers greater than zero, specifically for households with a completion status of 'Located', ordered by the count of household split numbers in descending order.
mt: ज्या कुटुंबांची स्थिती 'Located' (स्थित) आहे, अशा कुटुंबांसाठी शून्य पेक्षा जास्त 'household split numbers' (कुटुंब विभाजन संख्या) असलेल्या पहिल्या १० जिल्ह्यांचे जिल्हा कोड, त्यांच्या 'household split numbers' च्या उतरत्या क्रमानुसार सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: For casualties classified as pedestrians, list each sex of casualty along with the average casualty severity, grouped by the sex of the casualty.
mt: పాదచారులుగా వర్గీకరించిన ప్రమాదాల కోసం, ప్రతి సెక్స్ కాసువల్టీని సగటు సెక్స్ కాసువల్టీ తీవ్రతతో కూడా జాబితా చేయండి, సెక్స్ కాసువల్టీ ద్వారా సమూహీకరించబడింది.

src: For each age band of the driver, list the age band, the average number of casualties, and the total count of accident IDs.
mt: प्रत्येक वय गटासाठी, वय गट, सरासरी जखमींची संख्या, आणि अपघातांच्या आयडीची एकूण संख्या सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: For the state of Maharashtra, list the PSU codes in ascending order for all locations where the completion status is 'Located', provided that there is at least one household with a split number equal to zero.
mt: మహారాష్ట్ర రాష్ట్రానికి సంబంధించి, కనీసం ఒక ఇంటి విభజన సంఖ్య (split number) సున్నాగా ఉండి, పూర్తిస్థాయి స్థితి (completion status) 'Located' అని ఉన్న అన్ని ప్రాంతాల యొక్క PSU కోడ్‌లను ఆరోహణ క్రమంలో జాబితా చేయండి.

src: Rank the sub-districts by their total allopathic outpatient attendance, excluding those with no recorded visits.
mt: उपजिल्ह्यांची क्रमवारी त्यांच्या एकूण एलोपॅथिक आउटपेशंट उपस्थितीच्या आधारे लावा, ज्यांचा कोणताही नोंदवलेला भेटी नाही त्यांना वगळून.

src: List the district codes for the top 10 districts that have a count of household split numbers greater than zero, specifically for households with a completion status of 'Located', ordered by the count of household split numbers in descending order.
mt: வீட்டுப் பூர்த்தி நிலை 'Located' (கண்டறியப்பட்டது) என்று உள்ள வீடுகளில், பூஜ்ஜியத்திற்கும் அதிகமான 'household split numbers' (வீட்டுப் பிரிவு எண்கள்) கொண்ட முதல் 10 மாவட்டங்களின் குறியீடுகளை, அந்த எண்களின் எண்ணிக்கையின் அடிப்படையில் இறங்கு வரிசையில் பட்டியலிடவும்.

src: For stations located in the state with ID 1, what is the average maximum fecal streptococci MPN per 100ml and the corresponding type of water body, grouped by the water body type and ordered from highest to lowest average?
mt: ID 1 உள்ள மாநிலத்தில் அமைந்துள்ள நிலையங்களுக்கு, சராசரி அதிகபட்ச மল স্ট்रெப்டোகோக்கி MPN ஒரு 100ml மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய நீர் உடல் வகை என்ன, நீர் உடல் வகை மூலம் தொகுக்கப்பட்ட மற்றும் மிக உচ்சம் முதல் மிகக் குறைந்த சராசரி வரை வரிசைப்படுத்தப்பட்ட?

src: List the district names for the state named 'Andhra Pradesh', grouped and ordered alphabetically by district name.
mt: आंध्र प्रदेश राज्यासाठी जिल्ह्यांची नावे वर्णक्रमानुसार क्रमवारी आणि गटबद्ध करा.

src: Provide the caste or religious group, household asset index, and social network contact types for all households where the Gauna ceremony has taken place, sorted by their asset index.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
सर्व घरांसाठी ज्यांची गौणा समारंभ झाली आहे, त्यांच्या मालमत्ता निर्देशांकानुसार क्रमवारी लावून, त्यांची जात किंवा धार्मिक गट, घरगुती मालमत्ता निर्देशांक आणि सामाजिक संपर्क प्रकार प्रदान करा.

src: List the sub-district names where the total rural population of scheduled tribes is greater than zero and the total rural population of scheduled castes is exactly zero.
mt: షెడ్యూల్డ్ తెగల మొత్తం గ్రామీణ జనాభా సున్నా కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండి మరియు షెడ్యూల్డ్ కులాల మొత్తం గ్రామీణ జనాభా ఖచ్చితంగా సున్నాగా ఉన్న ఉప-జిల్లా పేర్లను జాబితా చేయండి.

src: Provide the chickpea and pigeon pea yields for each district and state recorded during the year 1970.
mt: या १९७० साली नोंदवलेल्या प्रत्येक जिल्हा आणि राज्यांसाठी चणा आणि तूर यांचे उत्पादन द्या.

src: List the distinct geography IDs for households where either the household split number is 1 or the completion status is 'Located'.
mt: ज्या कुटुंबांसाठी 'household split number' १ आहे किंवा 'completion status' 'Located' आहे, अशा कुटुंबांच्या वेगळ्या (distinct) 'geography IDs' ची यादी करा.

src: Identify all households that are either identified as Muslim or have a recorded date for the Gauna ceremony.
mt:
ही विनंती भाषांतरित करा:
अशा सर्व घरांबद्दल ओळखा जे एकतर मुस्लिम म्हणून ओळखले जातात किंवा गौणा समारंभाची नोंद असलेली तारीख आहे.

src: List the sub-district names for areas where the scheduled tribes rural population is greater than zero and the scheduled castes rural population is exactly zero.
mt: షెడ్యూల్డ్ తెగల గ్రామీణ జనాభా సున్నా కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండి మరియు షెడ్యూల్డ్ కులాల గ్రామీణ జనాభా ఖచ్చితంగా సున్నా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాల యొక్క ఉప-జిల్లా పేర్లను జాబితా చేయండి.

src: For stations located in the state with ID 1, what is the average maximum fecal streptococci MPN per 100ml and the corresponding type of water body, grouped by the water body type and ordered from highest to lowest average?
mt: ID 1 असलेल्या राज्यात स्थित स्टेशनसाठी, सरासरी कमाल मल स्ट्रेप्टोकोकी MPN प्रति 100ml आणि संबंधित जल शरीराचा प्रकार काय आहे, जल शरीराच्या प्रकारानुसार गटबद्ध केलेले आणि सर्वोच्च ते सर्वनिम्न सरासरीने क्रमबद्ध केलेले?

src: Show the education at migration codes and the total count of migrants for those whose activity status is 'Salaried' and whose married when migrated indicator is not null, grouped by their education at migration code and ordered by the count in descending order for the top 5 results.
mt: వలస వెళ్ళే సమయానికి వివాహ స్థితి (married when migrated indicator) ఖాళీగా లేని మరియు వారి ప్రస్తుత పని స్థితి 'జీతం పొందే ఉద్యోగి' (Salaried) గా ఉన్న వారిని, వారి వలస నాటి విద్యా కోడ్‌ల (education at migration codes) ఆధారంగా వర్గీకరించి, అత్యధిక వలసదారులు ఉన్న మొదటి 5 ఫలితాలను ఆ విద్యా కోడ్‌లు మరియు మొత్తం వలసదారుల సంఖ్యతో సహా చూపండి.

src: List the sub-districts, in alphabetical order, that have distributed more than 5,000 oral pill cycles or over 10,000 condoms.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
५,००० पेक्षा जास्त मौखिक गोळी चक्र वितरित केलेले किंवा १०,००० पेक्षा जास्त कंडोम वितरित केलेले उपजिल्हे, वर्णक्रमानुसार सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: Identify all households that either have an asset index of 27 or have a recorded date for the Gauna ceremony.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
अशा सर्व घरांना ओळखा ज्यांची मालमत्ता निर्देशांक 27 आहे किंवा ज्यांच्याकडे गौणा समारंभाची नोंद असलेली तारीख आहे.

src: Identify the top 10 urban districts with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, including their respective poverty line thresholds.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
सर्वोच्च सरासरी मासिक प्रति व्यक्ती उपभोग असलेले शीर्ष 10 शहरी जिल्हे ओळखा, त्यांच्या संबंधित दारिद्र्यरेषा थ्रेशोल्डसह.

src: List the casualty ID and the sex of the casualty for all individuals classified as pedestrians whose fitness was recorded as normal, ordered alphabetically by their sex.
mt: పాదచారులుగా వర్గీకరించబడిన మరియు ఫిట్‌నెస్ సాధారణంగా నమోదు చేయబడిన అన్ని వ్యక్తుల కోసం ఆకస్మిక ID మరియు ఆకస్మిక లింగాన్ని జాబితా చేయండి, వారి లింగం ద్వారా అక్షర క্రమంలో ఆదేశించబడింది.

src: Identify the top 10 rural districts with the highest average household member counts, specifically focusing on those within the second neighborhood category.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
दुसऱ्या शेजारी श्रेणीतील ग्रामीण जिल्ह्यांमध्ये सर्वाधिक सरासरी घरगुती सदस्य संख्या असलेल्या शीर्ष 10 ग्रामीण जिल्ह्यांची ओळख करा.

src: Identify the sub-districts that recorded more than 5,000 allopathic outpatient visits and administered over 1,000 BCG vaccines.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
५,००० पेक्षा जास्त एलोपॅथिक आउटपेशंट भेटी आणि १,००० पेक्षा जास्त बीसीजी लसीकरण नोंदवलेले उपजिल्हे ओळखा.

src: Show the education at migration codes and the total count of migrants for those whose activity status is 'Salaried' and whose married when migrated indicator is not null, grouped by their education at migration code and ordered by the count in descending order for the top 5 results.
mt: ज्यांचे क्रियाकलाप स्थिती 'पगारदार' (Salaried) आहे आणि ज्यांच्या स्थलांतराच्या वेळच्या वैवाहिक स्थितीचा निर्देशक रिक्त (not null) नाही, अशा व्यक्तींसाठी स्थलांतराच्या वेळचे शिक्षण कोड आणि स्थलांतरितांची एकूण संख्या दर्शवा; हे त्यांच्या स्थलांतराच्या वेळच्या शिक्षण कोडनुसार गटबद्ध करा आणि पहिल्या ५ निकालांसाठी ही संख्या उतरत्या क्रमाने लावा.

src: Provide the 2021 program management details, including immunization sessions and condom distribution, for sub-districts in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, categorized by area type.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
आंदमान आणि निकोबार बेटांमधील उप-जिल्ह्यांसाठी, क्षेत्र प्रकारानुसार वर्गीकृत, २०२१ च्या कार्यक्रम व्यवस्थापनाचा तपशील, लसीकरण सत्रे आणि कंडोम वितरणासहित प्रदान करा.

src: List the household IDs and their respective caste or religious group categories, ranked from highest to lowest based on their asset index.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
घरगुती आयडी आणि त्यांच्या संबंधित जात किंवा धार्मिक गट श्रेणी, त्यांच्या मालमत्ता निर्देशांकावर आधारित उच्च ते निम्न क्रमाने यादी करा.

src: List the sub-district names for the census year 2013 where the total number of establishments owned by Sikhs is greater than zero and the total number of establishments owned by Jains is exactly zero, grouped and ordered alphabetically by the sub-district name.
mt: 2013 च्या जनगणना वर्षासाठी शीख मालकीची प्रतिष्ठाने शून्यापेक्षा जास्त आणि जैन मालकीची प्रतिष्ठाने नीट शून्य असलेले उपजिल्ह्यांची नावे, उपजिल्हा नुसार वर्गीकृत आणि अल्फाबेटिकली क्रमवारी लावलेले यादी करा.

src: Show the sex of casualty and the average casualty severity for casualties who are either a driver, rider, or pedestrian and fall within the age bands of 18-30 or 31-50, grouped by their sex, where the average severity is greater than 1, and order the results by the average casualty severity in descending order.
mt: दुर्घटनाग्रस्तांचे लिंग आणि सरासरी दुर्घटनाग्रस्त गंभीरता दाखवा ज्यांचे लिंग, सरासरी गंभीरता 1 पेक्षा जास्त आहे, आणि परिणाम सरासरी दुर्घटनाग्रस्त गंभीरतेच्या उतरत्या क्रमाने क्रमांकित करा, जे ड्रायव्हर, राइडर किंवा पादचारी आहेत आणि 18-30 किंवा 31-50 वयोगटांमध्ये येतात, त्यांच्या लिंगानुसार गटबद्ध केलेले.

src: List the sub-district names for areas where the scheduled tribes rural population is greater than zero and the scheduled castes rural population is exactly zero.
mt: பழங்குடியின கிராமப்புற மக்கள் தொகை பூஜ்ஜியத்தை விட அதிகமாகவும், ஆதிதிராவிடர் கிராமப்புற மக்கள் தொகை சரியாக பூஜ்ஜியமாகவும் உள்ள பகுதிகளின் துணை மாவட்டப் பெயர்களைப் பட்டியலிடுங்கள்.

src: List the casualty class and the total count of bridge accident casualty IDs for records where the casualty severity is 2, specifically filtering for and showing only the 'Pedestrian' casualty class, ordered by the casualty class.
mt: दुर्घटना गंभीरता 2 असलेल्या रेकॉर्डसाठी जखमी वर्ग आणि पुल दुर्घटना जखमी आयडीची एकूण संख्या सूचीबद्ध करा, विशेषत: 'पादचारी' जखमी वर्गासाठी फिल्टर करा आणि केवळ दर्शवा, जखमी वर्गानुसार क्रमबद्ध करा.

src: For the most recent census year available, list each ULB RLB village name along with the total sum of human health and social establishments, sorted by the total sum in descending order.
mt: सर्वात अलीकडील जनगणना वर्षासाठी, प्रत्येक ULB RLB गावाचे नाव मानवी आरोग्य आणि सामाजिक संस्थांच्या एकूण बेरीजीसह यादी करा, एकूण बेरीजनुसार उतरत्या क्रमाने क्रमवारी लावून.

src: List the household ID, the household number, the new household split number, and the completion status for all records where the household split number is 1, ordered by the household ID.
mt: ज्या सर्व नोंदींमध्ये 'household split number' १ आहे, अशा सर्व नोंदींसाठी 'household ID', 'household number', 'new household split number' आणि 'completion status' यांची यादी करा आणि ती 'household ID' नुसार क्रमाने लावा.

src: List the light conditions and the weather conditions for each unique combination of these two factors that is associated with at least one accident.
mt: प्रत्येक अद्वितीय संयोजनासाठी प्रकाश परिस्थिती आणि हवामान परिस्थिती सूचीबद्ध करा जी किमान एक अपघातासह संबंधित आहे.

src: Identify the sub-districts that recorded at least one child receiving the second DPT booster (after age 5) in 2021 across both urban and rural areas, listed alphabetically.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
२०२१ मध्ये शहरी आणि ग्रामीण दोन्ही भागात, पाच वर्षांनंतर दुसरा डीपीटी बूस्टर घेतलेले किमान एक मूल नोंदवलेले उपजिल्हे, वर्णक्रमानुसार सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: List the sub-district names and the total number of establishments owned by Sikhs for the time period with ID 1, grouped by sub-district and ordered by the highest count first, showing only the top 5 results.
mt: उप-जिल्ह्यांची नावे आणि तांत्रिक कालावधी आयडी 1 साठी सिख मालकीच्या एकूण संस्थांची संख्या यादी करा, उप-जिल्ह्यानुसार गटबद्ध करून, सर्वाधिक संख्येनुसार क्रमवारीत लावून, फक्त शीर्ष 5 परिणाम दाखवा.

src: List the casualty class and the total count of bridge accident casualty IDs for records where the casualty severity is 2, specifically filtering for and showing only the 'Pedestrian' casualty class, ordered by the casualty class.
mt: క్షతిగ్రస్త వర్గం మరియు సేతువు ప్రమాదం క్షతిగ్రస్త IDల మొత్తం సంఖ్యను జాబితా చేయండి, ఇక్కడ క్షతిగ్రస్త తీవ్రత 2, ప్రత్యేకంగా 'పాదచారి' క్షతిగ్రస్త వర్గం కోసం ఫిల్టర్ చేసి చూపించండి, క్షతిగ్రస్త వర్గం ద్వారా ఆర్డర్ చేయండి.

src: List the casualty IDs for all casualties classified as pedestrians where the casualty severity level is 2.
mt: सर्व पादचाऱ्यांचे नुकसान आयडी सूचीबद्ध करा जेथे नुकसानीचे गंभीरता स्तर 2 आहे.

src: Provide a breakdown of oral pill cycles and condoms distributed in 2021 by area type, ranked by the volume of pill distribution for areas with active distribution.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
२०२१ मध्ये मौखिक गोळी चक्र आणि वितरित केलेल्या कंडोमचे क्षेत्र प्रकारानुसार विभाजन प्रदान करा, सक्रिय वितरण असलेल्या क्षेत्रांसाठी गोळी वितरणाच्या प्रमाणानुसार क्रमवारी लावा.

src: List the district names and sub-district names for all districts and sub-districts that have a total number of Ayurvedic dispensaries and a total number of Homeopathic dispensaries of at least zero, ordered alphabetically by district name.
mt: కనీసం సున్నా ఆయుర్వేద డిస్పెన్సరీలు మరియు కనీసం సున్నా హోమియోపతి డిస్పెన్సరీలు కలిగిన అన్ని జిల్లాలు మరియు ఉప-జిల్లాల పేర్లను జాబితా చేయండి, వీటిని జిల్లాల పేర్ల వారీగా అక్షర క్రమంలో అమర్చండి.

src: Provide a breakdown of the average social ID and the total number of animal care workers, grouped by caste/religion category and social network contact type, for all households with recorded members, sorted by the highest average social ID.
mt: सर्व नोंदवलेल्या घरांसाठी, जात/धर्म श्रेणी आणि सामाजिक नेटवर्क संपर्क प्रकारानुसार गटबद्ध, सर्वाधिक सामाजिक ID सरासरीच्या क्रमाने, सामाजिक ID सरासरीची विभागणी आणि प्राणी संगोपन कर्मचाऱ्यांची एकूण संख्या प्रदान करा.

src: Identify the months that either belong to the year 2022 or recorded more than 5,000 allopathic outpatient visits, sorted alphabetically.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
२०२२ या वर्षातील किंवा ५,००० पेक्षा जास्त एलोपॅथिक रुग्णांची दर्शनी भेट नोंदवलेल्या महिन्यांची ओळख करा, वर्णक्रमानुसार क्रमवारी लावा.

src: List the district codes for the top 10 districts that have a count of household split numbers greater than zero, specifically for households with a completion status of 'Located', ordered by the count of household split numbers in descending order.
mt: పూర్తయిన స్థితి 'Located' అని ఉన్న గృహాలలో, సున్నా కంటే ఎక్కువ హౌస్‌హోల్డ్ స్ప్లిట్ నంబర్లు (household split numbers) కలిగిన మొదటి 10 జిల్లాల కోడ్‌లను, ఆ స్ప్లిట్ నంబర్ల సంఖ్య ఆధారంగా అవరోహణ క్రమంలో జాబితా చేయండి.

src: Identify the rural sub-districts that recorded allopathic outpatient attendance in 2022, excluding any sub-districts that also have urban areas with reported attendance for that same year.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
२०२२ मध्ये अॅलोपॅथिक आउटपेशंट उपस्थिती नोंदवलेल्या ग्रामीण उपजिल्ह्यांची ओळख करा, अशा कोणत्याही उपजिल्ह्यांना वगळून ज्यांच्या शहरी भागातही त्या वर्षासाठी नोंदवलेली उपस्थिती आहे.

src: For the state of Andhra Pradesh, list the district names and the count of distinct ULB/RLB village names, grouped by district name and ordered by the highest count of villages, showing only the top 10 results.
mt: आंध्र प्रदेश राज्यासाठी, जिल्हानुसार गटबद्ध करून, सर्वाधिक गावांच्या संख्येनुसार क्रमवारीत केवळ शीर्ष १० परिणाम दाखवत, जिल्ह्यांची नावे आणि वेगळ्या ULB/RLB गावांच्या नावांची संख्या यादी करा.

src: List the top 10 district codes, ordered by the highest count of household split numbers, specifically for districts that have at least one household split number recorded.
mt: कमीतकमी एक 'हाऊसहोल्ड स्प्लिट नंबर' (household split number) नोंदवलेल्या जिल्ह्यांपैकी, सर्वाधिक 'हाऊसहोल्ड स्प्लिट नंबर' असलेल्या पहिल्या १० जिल्हा कोडची यादी करा.

src: List the household ID, the household number, the household split number, and the state code for all records where the household split number is 1, ordered by the household ID.
mt: ज्या सर्व नोंदींमध्ये 'household split number' १ आहे, अशा नोंदींसाठी 'household ID', 'household number', 'household split number' आणि 'state code' यांची यादी करा आणि ती 'household ID' नुसार क्रमाने लावा.

src: Calculate the average of the maximum fecal streptococci MPN per 100ml values, where these maximums are first determined for each type of water body for the year 2023.
mt: २०२३ साठी प्रत्येक प्रकारच्या जलस्रोतासाठी प्रथम निर्धारित केलेल्या कमाल मल स्ट्रेप्टोकोकी एमपीएन प्रति १००मिली मूल्यांचा सरासरी मूल्य मोजा.

src: Confirm the name of the state of Assam from the list of states that have recorded district information.
mt: மாநிலங்களின் பட்டியலில் இருந்து அசாம் மாநிலத்தின் பெயரை உறுதிப்படுத்தவும்.

src: Identify the IDs of all households with an asset index of 27, excluding any households where children have an unknown school enrollment status, and list them in ascending order.
mt: सर्व घरांमध्ये ज्यांचा आसाम इंडेक्स 27 आहे, त्यांची ID ओळखा, ज्यातील मुलांची शाळेत नोंदणीची स्थिती अज्ञात आहे अशी कोणतीही घरे वगळा, आणि त्यांना चढत्या क्रमाने सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: List all rural sub-districts that reported at least some allopathic outpatient attendance during the year 2022, sorted alphabetically.
mt:
या विनंतीचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
२०२२ या वर्षात किमान काही अॅलोपॅथिक रुग्णांनी बाह्यरुग्ण विभागात हजेरी दिलेले सर्व ग्रामीण उपजिल्हे, वर्णक्रमानुसार यादी करा.

src: Provide the asset index and secondary social network contact types for households from the OBC category that have recorded utility consumption, sorted by their wealth status.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
ओबीसी श्रेणीतील घरांसाठी, ज्यांनी उपयुक्तता वापर नोंदवला आहे, त्यांच्या संपत्तीच्या स्थितीनुसार क्रमवारी लावून, मालमत्ता निर्देशांक आणि दुय्यम सामाजिक नेटवर्क संपर्क प्रकार प्रदान करा.

src: For the most recent census year available, list each sub-district name and the total sum of estimated residential commercial establishments, filtering for records where the estimated residential commercial value is 0.000, and order the results by the sum in descending order.
mt: सर्वात अलीकडील उपलब्ध जनगणना वर्षासाठी, प्रत्येक उप-जिल्ह्याचे नाव आणि अंदाजे निवासी व्यावसायिक संस्थांची एकूण बेरीज यादी करा, जिथे अंदाजे निवासी व्यावसायिक मूल्य 0.000 असलेल्या नोंदी फिल्टर करा, आणि परिणामांना बेरीजनुसार उतरत्या क्रमाने लावा.

src: List the district codes and the count of household split numbers for each district, considering only households with a completion status of 'Located', and show the top 5 districts with the highest counts.
mt: ज्या कुटुंबांची स्थिती 'Located' आहे, अशा कुटुंबांचा विचार करून प्रत्येक जिल्ह्यासाठी जिल्हा कोड आणि हाऊसहोल्ड स्प्लिट नंबरची संख्या सूचीबद्ध करा आणि सर्वाधिक संख्या असलेले पहिले ५ जिल्हे दाखवा.

src: List the casualty IDs for casualties classified as pedestrians where the fitness of the casualty is normal, grouped by their casualty ID.
mt: காலணி நிலை சாதாரணமாக இருக்கும் பாதசாரிகளாக வகைப்படுத்தப்பட்ட உயிரிழப்புகளுக்கான உயிரிழப்பு IDகளை பட்டியலிடுங்கள், அவற்றின் உயிரிழப்பு IDக்களால் தொகுக்கப்பட்டவை.

src: Identify the sub-districts that recorded at least one child receiving the second DPT booster (DPT 5) in 2021 across both rural and urban areas.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
२०२१ मध्ये ग्रामीण आणि शहरी दोन्ही भागात दुसरा डीपीटी बूस्टर (डीपीटी ५) मिळालेले किमान एक मूल नोंदवलेले उपजिल्हे ओळखा.

src: For each state code, list the state code itself, the total count of household IDs, and the average household split number.
mt: प्रत्येक राज्य कोडसाठी, तो राज्य कोड स्वतः, हाऊसहोल्ड आयडीची (household IDs) एकूण संख्या आणि सरासरी हाऊसहोल्ड स्प्लिट नंबरची (household split number) यादी करा.

src: For each state code, list the state code itself, the total count of household IDs, and the average household split number.
mt: प्रत्येक राज्य कोडसाठी, तो राज्य कोड स्वतः, हाऊसहोल्ड आयडीची (household IDs) एकूण संख्या आणि सरासरी हाऊसहोल्ड स्प्लिट नंबरची (household split number) यादी करा.

src: Identify all households with an asset index of 27 that do not have any animal care workers, sorted by their ID.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
२७ च्या आसामी निर्देशांक असलेले सर्व घरगुती ओळखा ज्यात कोणतेही पशुसंगोपन कामगार नाहीत, त्यांच्या आयडीनुसार क्रमवारी लावा.

src: List the driver ID and the age band of the driver for all records where the driving experience is '1-2yr' or the educational level is 'Junior high school', ordered by the driver ID.
mt: ड्राइव्हर आयडी आणि ड्राइव्हरचे वय गट सूचीबद्ध करा सर्व रेकॉर्डसाठी जेथे ड्राइव्हिंग अनुभव '1-2yr' आहे किंवा शैक्षणिक स्तर 'जूनियर हाय स्कूल' आहे, ड्राइव्हर आयडीनुसार क्रमवारीत.

src: Provide the annual sunflower cultivation statistics, including area, production, and yield, for all districts in Chhattisgarh, ordered chronologically.
mt:
ही विनंती भाषांतरित करा:
छत्तीसगढ़ातील सर्व जिल्ह्यांसाठी वार्षिक सूर्यफूल लागवडीची आकडेवारी, क्षेत्र, उत्पादन आणि उत्पादनाचा समावेश करून, कालक्रमानुसार क्रमवारीत प्रदान करा.

src: List the outpatient IDs and their corresponding allopathic attendance counts for December 2022, focusing only on those with recorded visits, sorted from highest to lowest attendance.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
डिसेंबर २०२२ मधील आउटपेशंट आयडी आणि त्यांचे संबंधित एलोपॅथिक उपस्थिती संख्या यादी करा, फक्त नोंदणीकृत भेटी असलेल्यांवर लक्ष केंद्रित करून, उच्चतम ते निम्नतम उपस्थितीच्या क्रमाने क्रमवारी लावा.

src: List the station names for stations located in the state of 'Andhra Pradesh' where the maximum recorded fecal streptococci MPN per 100ml is greater than 1, grouped by the station name.
mt: 'Andhra Pradesh' రాష్ట్రంలో ఉన్న స్టేషన్‌ల కోసం స్టేషన్ పేర్లను జాబితా చేయండి, ఇక్కడ గరిష్ట నమోదు చేసిన ఫెకల్ స్ట్రెప్టోకోకి MPN 100ml కంటే ఎక్కువ, స్టేషన్ పేరు ద్వారా సమూహీకరించబడింది.

src: Provide a breakdown of the total oral pill cycles and condoms distributed in 2021, categorized by the type of area.
mt: २०२१ मध्ये वितरित केलेल्या एकूण मौखिक गोळी चक्र आणि कंडोमचे विवरण, क्षेत्राच्या प्रकारानुसार विभागून द्या.

src: List the names of districts in Assam that contain more than one rural sub-district, sorted alphabetically.
mt: असमातील अधिकृत ग्रामीण उपजिल्हा असलेल्या जिल्ह्यांची नावे वर्णक्रमानुसार सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: List the station names for stations located in the state of 'Andhra Pradesh' where the maximum recorded fecal streptococci MPN per 100ml is greater than 1, grouped by the station name.
mt: अंध्र प्रदेश राज्यात स्थित स्टेशनचे नाव सूचीबद्ध करा जेथे कमाल नोंदवलेले मल स्ट्रेप्टोकोकाय MPN प्रति 100ml 1 पेक्षा जास्त आहे, स्टेशनचे नाव अनुसार गटबद्ध केले आहे.

src: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average number of married women and the total number of children under 15 per household, categorized by urban and rural areas.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
शहरी आणि ग्रामीण भागांनुसार वर्गीकृत, प्रत्येक राज्यातील सरासरी लग्न झालेल्या महिलांची संख्या आणि १५ वर्षाखालील मुलांची एकूण संख्या प्रति कुटुंब द्या.

src: Identify the sub-districts that reported outpatient services in both rural and urban areas during the year 2021.
mt: 2021లో రుణ మరియు పట్టణ ప్రాంతాలలో రుగ్మత సేవలు నివేదించిన ఉప-జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి.

src: Show the average maximum fecal streptococci MPN per 100ml and the corresponding type of water body, grouped by the type of water body and ordered from the highest average concentration to the lowest.
mt: सर्वोच्च सरासरी मल स्ट्रेप्टोकोकी एमपीएन प्रति १००मिली आणि संबंधित जलस्रोताचा प्रकार दाखवा, जलस्रोताच्या प्रकारानुसार गटबद्ध करा आणि सर्वोच्च सरासरी एकाग्रतेपासून सर्वनिम्न पर्यंत क्रमवारीत करा.

src: Provide a breakdown of households with outstanding loans involved in activity subtype 40, categorized by their asset index and caste-religion group.
mt: कृपया कर्ज असलेल्या घरगुती कर्जदारांचे विवरण द्या, जे उपप्रकार ४० मध्ये सहभागी आहेत, त्यांच्या मालमत्ता निर्देशांक आणि जात-धर्म गटानुसार वर्गीकृत केलेले.

src: Which sub-districts reported at least one first dose of the Rotavirus vaccine but zero third doses during the year 2021?
mt: 2021 సంవత్సరంలో రోటావైరస్ వ్యాక్సిన్ యొక్క కనీసం ఒక మొదటి డోస్ నివేదించబడిన, కానీ మూడవ డోస్ సున్నా ఉన్న ఉప-జిల్లాలు ఏవి?

src: List the casualty IDs for casualties classified as pedestrians where the casualty severity level is 2.
mt: காலணிப் பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர்களாக வகைப்படுத்தப்பட்ட பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர்களின் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட ID களை பட்டியலிடுங்கள், அங்கு பாதிக்கப்பட்ட தீவிரத்தன்மை நிலை 2 ஆகும்.

src: List the occupation description and the education at death code for all records where the education at death code is 'Illiterate', grouped by both the occupation description and the education code, and ordered alphabetically by occupation description.
mt: ज्या सर्व नोंदींमध्ये मृत्यूसमयीच्या शिक्षणाचा कोड 'Illiterate' (निरक्षर) आहे, अशा सर्व नोंदींसाठी व्यवसायाचे वर्णन आणि मृत्यूसमयीच्या शिक्षणाचा कोड यांची यादी करा; ही माहिती व्यवसायाचे वर्णन आणि शिक्षण कोड या दोन्हीनुसार गटबद्ध (grouped) करा आणि व्यवसायाच्या वर्णनानुसार वर्णक्रमानुसार (alphabetically) लावा.

src: List the state IDs for states that have stations located on lakes, excluding those state IDs that have stations located on tanks.
mt: झीलांवर स्थित स्टेशन असलेल्या राज्यांची राज्य आयडी सूचीबद्ध करा, टाकांवर स्थित स्टेशन असलेल्या राज्य आयडी वगळून.

src: List the household IDs for all households where the same address indicator is marked as 'Yes'.
mt: ज्या कुटुंबांसाठी 'समान पत्ता निर्देशक' (same address indicator) 'हो' (Yes) म्हणून चिन्हांकित केला आहे, अशा सर्व कुटुंबांचे आयडी (IDs) सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: List the light conditions and weather conditions for all environmental settings where the total number of casualties exceeds 2, and display these results in descending order based on the total sum of casualties.
mt: सर्व पर्यावरणीय सेटिंग्जसाठी प्रकाश परिस्थिती आणि हवामान परिस्थिती सूचीबद्ध करा जेथे एकूण मृत्यूदंड संख्या 2 पेक्षा जास्त आहे, आणि एकूण मृत्यूदंडांच्या एकूण बेरजेच्या आधारे हे परिणाम उतरत्या क्रमाने प्रदर्शित करा.

src: Calculate the average of the maximum fecal streptococci MPN per 100ml values, where these maximums are first determined for each type of water body for the year 2023.
mt: 2023 ஆம் ஆண்டிற்கான ஒவ்வொரு நீர்நிலை வகைக்கும் முதலில் அதிகபட்சம் நிர்ணயிக்கப்பட்ட பின்னர், இந்த அதிகபட்சங்களின் மலம் சிதைவு ஸ்ட்ரெப்டோகோக்கி MPN ஒரு 100ml மதிப்புகளின் சராசரியைக் கணக்கிடுக.

src: Identify the geography IDs for areas that either have a village health facility or a monthly per capita consumption exceeding 3,667, ensuring only locations with at least one recorded consumption entry are included.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
अशा भागांचे भूगोल आयडी ओळखा ज्यामध्ये एकतर गावातील आरोग्य सुविधा आहे किंवा मासिक प्रति व्यक्ती उपभोग ३,६६७ पेक्षा जास्त आहे, हे सुनिश्चित करा की किमान एक नोंदवलेला उपभोग नोंद असलेल्या स्थानांचा समावेश आहे.

src: List the household ID, the household number, and the state code for all records where the household split number is greater than zero and the state code is 'Rajasthan'.
mt: வீட்டுப் பிரிப்பு எண் (household split number) பூஜ்ஜியத்தை விட அதிகமாகவும், மாநிலக் குறியீடு (state code) 'ராஜஸ்தான்' என்றும் உள்ள அனைத்துப் பதிவுகளுக்கான குடும்ப அடையாள எண் (household ID), குடும்ப எண் (household number) மற்றும் மாநிலக் குறியீடு ஆகியவற்றைப் பட்டியலிடவும்.

src: Provide a list of states and districts that had active sunflower production, ordered by the most recent year.
mt: సూర్యకాంతి ఉత్పత్తి కలిగిన రాష్ట్రాలు మరియు జిల్లాల జాబితాను అందించండి, ఇటీవలి సంవత్సరం ఆధారంగా క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడింది.

src: For the census year 2013, considering only the record with the maximum time ID available, list the names of the ULB, RLB, or villages where the total sum of establishments owned by females is exactly zero.
mt: २०१३ च्या जनगणना वर्षासाठी, केवळ सर्वाधिक वेळ आयडी उपलब्ध असलेल्या नोंदीचा विचार करून, ज्या अर्धशहरी स्थानिक स्वराज्य संस्था (ULB), ग्रामीण स्थानिक स्वराज्य संस्था (RLB) किंवा गावांमध्ये महिलांच्या मालकीच्या संस्थांची एकूण बेरीज नक्की शून्य आहे, त्यांची नावे यादी करा.

src: List the sub-district name and district name, along with the total number of ayurvedic dispensaries and the total number of allopathic hospitals for each sub-district and district combination where the total number of homeopathic dispensaries is greater than zero.
mt: ஒவ்வொரு துணை மாவட்டம் மற்றும் மாவட்டக் கூட்டிற்கும், ஹோமியோபதி மருந்தகங்களின் மொத்த எண்ணிக்கை பூஜ்ஜியத்தை விட அதிகமாக உள்ள இடங்களில், துணை மாவட்டப் பெயர் மற்றும் மாவட்டப் பெயருடன், ஆயுர்வேத மருந்தகங்களின் மொத்த எண்ணிக்கை மற்றும் அலோபதி மருத்துவமனைகளின் மொத்த எண்ணிக்கை ஆகியவற்றைப் பட்டியலிடவும்.

src: List the sub-district names, sorted alphabetically, for all sub-districts that have at least one finance source record where both the estimated government financial assistance and the estimated amount borrowed from institutions are equal to 0.000.
mt: सर्व उप-जिल्ह्यांसाठी उप-जिल्ह्यांची नावे वर्णक्रमानुसार क्रमवारी लावा, जिथे किमान एक आर्थिक स्रोत नोंद असे आहे जिथे अंदाजे सरकारी आर्थिक मदत आणि संस्थांकडून कर्ज घेतलेली अंदाजे रक्कम दोन्ही 0.000 आहे.

src: Identify the sub-districts that, in 2021, reported either more than 15 Rotavirus 1 immunizations in rural areas or more than 1 Vitamin A first dose administrations in urban areas, listed alphabetically.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
२०२१ मध्ये, ग्रामीण भागात १५ पेक्षा जास्त रोटाव्हायरस १ लसीकरण किंवा शहरी भागात १ पेक्षा जास्त व्हिटॅमिन ए पहिली डोस प्रशासन अहवालित केलेल्या उप-जिल्ह्यांची वर्णक्रमानुसार यादी करा.

src: List the unique sub-districts that either are classified as rural or recorded outpatient services during the year 2022.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
२०२२ या वर्षात ग्रामीण वर्गीकृत असलेल्या किंवा आउटपेशंट सेवा नोंदवलेल्या अद्वितीय उपजिल्ह्यांची यादी करा.

src: Identify the rural districts that contain households living above the poverty line, excluding any urban districts that also have households above the poverty line.
mt: गरीबी रेषेच्या वर राहणाऱ्या घरांसह ग्रामीण जिल्हे ओळखा, गरीबी रेषेच्या वर राहणाऱ्या घरांसह असलेले कोणतेही शहरी जिल्हे वगळून.

src: Identify the top 5 rural districts with the highest average number of married women per household, considering only those districts with more than one household record.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
एकापेक्षा जास्त घरगुती नोंदी असलेल्या जिल्ह्यांचा विचार करून, प्रत्येक घरातील सरासरी विवाहित महिलांच्या संख्येनुसार शीर्ष ५ ग्रामीण जिल्हे ओळखा.

src: Grouped by the age band of the driver, what is the age band, the average number of casualties, and the total count of unique accident IDs for those drivers involved in more than one accident, ordered by the average number of casualties in descending order?
mt: ड्रायव्हरच्या वयोगटानुसार गटबद्ध केले असता, वयोगट, सरासरी जखमींची संख्या, आणि एकापेक्षा जास्त अपघातांमध्ये सामील असलेल्या ड्रायव्हरसाठी अद्वितीय अपघात आयडीची एकूण संख्या किती आहे, सरासरी जखमींची संख्या उतरत्या क्रमानुसार क्रमबद्ध केली आहे?

src: For environments where the light conditions are 'Darkness - no lighting', list each environment ID and the total count of accident IDs, provided that the sum of the number of casualties for that environment ID is greater than 5.
mt: अंधार - कोणतेही प्रकाश नसलेल्या प्रकाश परिस्थितीच्या वातावरणांसाठी, प्रत्येक वातावरण ID आणि अपघात IDची एकूण संख्या सूचीबद्ध करा, बशर्ते की त्या वातावरण ID साठी हताहतांच्या संख्येची बेरीज 5 पेक्षा जास्त असेल.

src: List the driving experience levels and the total count of accident IDs for drivers who either have '1-2yr' of driving experience or an educational level of 'Junior high school', grouping the results by driving experience and including only those groups with more than 1 accident.
mt: ड्राइव्हिंग अनुभव स्तर आणि अपघात आयडीची एकूण संख्या सूचीबद्ध करा ज्या ड्राइव्हरसाठी '1-2yr' ड्राइव्हिंग अनुभव आहे किंवा शैक्षणिक स्तर 'जूनियर हाই स्कूल' आहे, परिणाम ड्राइव्हिंग अनुभवानुसार गटबद्ध करा आणि केवळ 1 पेक्षा जास्त अपघात असलेले गट समाविष्ट करा.

src: List all rural sub-districts that reported at least some allopathic outpatient attendance during the year 2022, sorted alphabetically.
mt:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
2022 के दौरान कुछ आलोपैथिक आउटपेशेंट उपस्थिति दर्ज करने वाले सभी ग्रामीण उप-जिलों की सूची बनाएं, वर्णानुक्रम में व्यवस्थित करें।

src: List the sub-district names, ordered alphabetically, that had a total number of establishments greater than zero but zero residential or commercial establishments during the 2013 census year.
mt: 2013 జనగణన సంవత్సరంలో, మొత్తం సంస్థల సంఖ్య సున్నా కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండి, నివాస లేదా వాణిజ్య సంస్థలు సున్నాగా ఉన్న ఉప-జిల్లా పేర్లను వర్ణమాల క్రమంలో జాబితా చేయండి.

src: Show all columns from the casualty dimension for records where the casualty class is 'Pedestrian' and the fitness of the casualty is 'Normal'.
mt: క్షతిగ్రస్త వర్గం 'పాదచారి' మరియు క్షతిగ్రస్త ఫిట్‌నెస్ 'సాధారణ' ఉన్న రికార్డ్‌ల కోసం క్షతిగ్రస్త డైమెన్షన్ నుండి అన్ని నిలువు వరుసలను చూపించండి.

src: For each person ID and household split number, find the maximum age and the household split number, filtering for those where the maximum age is greater than 13, and list the top 10 results sorted by the maximum age in descending order.
mt: प्रत्येक व्यक्तीचा आयडी (ID) आणि कुटुंबाच्या विभाजनाच्या क्रमांकासाठी (household split number), जास्तीत जास्त वय आणि कुटुंबाच्या विभाजनाचा क्रमांक शोधा, ज्यामध्ये जास्तीत जास्त वय १३ पेक्षा जास्त आहे असे निकाल निवडा, आणि जास्तीत जास्त वयानुसार उतरत्या क्रमाने पहिल्या १० निकालांची यादी करा.

src: Rank the sub-districts and their area types by the total number of allopathic outpatient visits recorded throughout 2021, starting with the highest attendance.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
सर्वाधिक उपस्थितीपासून सुरुवात करून, २०२१ मध्ये नोंदवलेल्या सर्व एलोपॅथिक रुग्णांच्या एकूण संख्येनुसार उपजिल्हे आणि त्यांच्या क्षेत्र प्रकारांची श्रेणी द्या.

src: List the casualty IDs for casualties classified as pedestrians where the fitness of the casualty is normal, grouped by their casualty ID.
mt: पादचारी म्हणून वर्गीकृत केलेल्या जखमींच्या जखमी आयडी सूचीबद्ध करा जेथे जखमीचा फिटनेस सामान्य आहे, त्यांच्या जखमी आयडीनुसार गटबद्ध केलेले.

src: Rank the months of 2022 from highest to lowest based on the total number of allopathic outpatient visits.
mt: २०२२च्या महिन्यांची सर्व आलोपथिक आउटपेशंट भेटींच्या एकूण संख्येवरून उच्च ते निम्न क्रमाने मांडणी करा.

src: For each activity status and education at migration code, what is the activity status, the education at migration code, and the total count of migrant IDs, including only those combinations with more than zero migrants, sorted by the count in descending order?
mt: प्रत्येक क्रियाकलाप स्थिती (activity status) आणि स्थलांतरण वेळेची शिक्षण पातळी (education at migration code) यांच्यासाठी, क्रियाकलाप स्थिती, स्थलांतरण वेळेची शिक्षण पातळी आणि स्थलांतरित आयडींची (migrant IDs) एकूण संख्या काय आहे? यामध्ये फक्त अशाच जोड्यांचा समावेश करा ज्यामध्ये स्थलांतरितांची संख्या शून्यापेक्षा जास्त आहे आणि ही यादी संख्येनुसार उतरत्या क्रमाने (descending order) लावा.

src: Identify the rural sub-districts that had maternal ANC registrations in 2022 but did not record any in 2021.
mt:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
2022లో తల్లిగా ANC నమోదు చేసుకున్న గ్రామీణ ఉప జిల్లాలను గుర్తించంగా, కానీ 2021లో ఏవీ రికార్డ్ చేయబడలేదు.

src: For accidents occurring on a Monday, list each area where an accident occurred along with the average number of casualties and the total count of accident IDs, grouped by the area of the accident.
mt: सोमवारी घडलेल्या अपघातांसाठी, प्रत्येक क्षेत्र जेथे अपघात घडला तेथे सूचीबद्ध करा आणि सरासरी मृत्यूदंड संख्या आणि अपघात आयडीची एकूण संख्या, अपघाताच्या क्षेत्रानुसार गटबद्ध केली.

src: Identify the states and districts that contain households either belonging to the Brahmin group or ranking 21 on the household assets index, sorted alphabetically by state.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचा मराठी अनुवाद:
ब्राह्मण गटातील किंवा घरगुती मालमत्ता निर्देशांकावर २१ क्रमांक असलेल्या घरांच्या राज्ये आणि जिल्हे ओळखा, राज्यांच्या नावानुसार क्रमवारीत मांडा.

src: List the household IDs for households where all members are at least 22 years old, but specifically only those households where none of the members have a marital status code indicating they are married.
mt: अशा कुटुंबांचे आयडी (IDs) सूचीबद्ध करा ज्यांमधील सर्व सदस्यांचे वय किमान २२ वर्षे आहे, परंतु विशेषतः फक्त अशीच कुटुंबे निवडा ज्यांमधील कोणत्याही सदस्याची वैवाहिक स्थिती 'विवाहित' नाही.

src: List the top five sub-districts in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands with the highest total number of first-dose Vitamin A administrations recorded in 2021.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
२०२१ मध्ये नोंदवलेल्या पहिल्या डोसच्या व्हिटॅमिन ए प्रशासनाच्या एकूण संख्येसह अंदमान आणि निकोबार बेटांमधील शीर्ष पाच उप-जिल्ह्यांची यादी करा.

src: List the sub-district names, ordered alphabetically, for records where either the census year is 2013 and the village name is 'Chouldari (Rv)' or the number of establishments owned by other genders is 0.000, ensuring that at least one time record exists for each sub-district.
mt: ज्या उपजिल्ह्यांच्या नावांची यादी अक्षरानुक्रमान करावी, जिथे एकतर जनगणना वर्ष 2013 आणि गावाचे नाव 'चौलदारी (Rv)' असेल किंवा इतर लिंगांच्या मालकीच्या संस्थांची संख्या 0.000 असेल, आणि प्रत्येक उपजिल्ह्यासाठी किमान एक वेळेचा रेकॉर्ड अस्तित्वात असलेला असावा.

src: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban or contain households with more than three residents aged 15 to 21.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
शहरी वर्गीकृत असलेले किंवा 15 ते 21 वयोगटातील तीनहून अधिक सदस्य असलेल्या घरांसह राज्ये आणि जिल्हे ओळखा.

src: List the casualty ID, the casualty class, the sex of the casualty, and the accident severity for casualties classified as 'Pedestrian' who have a 'Normal' fitness level, ensuring each casualty is associated with at least one accident, and order the results by the casualty class.
mt: पादचारी म्हणून वर्गीकृत केलेल्या जखमींसाठी जखमी आयडी, जखमी वर्ग, जखमीचे लिंग आणि अपघात गंभीरता सूचीबद्ध करा ज्यांचे 'सामान्य' फिटनेस स्तर आहे, प्रत्येक जखमी कमीतकमी एका अपघाताशी संबंधित आहे याची खात्री करून, आणि परिणाम जखमी वर्गानुसार क्रमबद्ध करा.

src: Provide a breakdown by state and village healthcare availability showing the average monthly per capita consumption and total non-food expenditure.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
राज्य आणि गावानुसार आरोग्यसेवा उपलब्धतेचे विभाजन दर्शवा, ज्यामध्ये सरासरी मासिक प्रति व्यक्ती उपभोग आणि एकूण अन्नेतर खर्च दाखवला आहे.

src: Which rural sub-districts reported at least some Rotavirus 1 vaccinations in 2022 but had zero recorded Vitamin A first doses?
mt:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
2022లో రోటావైరస్ 1 టీకాలు కనీసం కొన్ని నమోదు చేయబడిన, కానీ విటమిన్ ఎ మొదటి డోస్ సున్నా నమోదు చేయబడిన గ్రామీణ ఉప-జిల్లాలు ఏవి?

src: Provide a yearly breakdown of the total allopathic outpatient attendance, ordered chronologically.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
एकूण ऍलोपॅथिक रुग्णांच्या वर्षवार बाह्यरुग्ण उपस्थितीचे कालक्रमानुसार विभाजन द्या.

src: List the accident IDs for cases involving drivers with 1-2 years of driving experience, where the total sum of casualties for each accident is greater than 3, ordered by the maximum number of casualties in descending order.
mt: ड्रायव्हिंग अनुभव 1-2 वर्षांच्या ड्रायव्हरांचा समावेश असलेल्या अपघातांचे आयडी सूचीबद्ध करा, जेथे प्रत्येक अपघातासाठी हताहतांची एकूण बेरीज 3 पेक्षा जास्त आहे, हताहतांच्या कमाल संख्येनुसार उतरत्या क्रमाने क्रमबद्ध करा.

src: List the household IDs and their corresponding caste or religious group categories, ordered from highest to lowest household asset index.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
कुटुंब मालमत्ता निर्देशांकानुसार उच्चतम ते निम्नतम क्रमाने, घरगुती आयडी आणि त्यांच्या संबंधित जात किंवा धार्मिक गट श्रेणी यांची यादी करा.

src: List the ULB RLB village names, sorted alphabetically, for locations where the number of forestry and logging establishments is greater than zero or the number of residential and commercial establishments is greater than zero.
mt: అడవి మరియు కలప వ్యాపార సంస్థల సంఖ్య సున్నా కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉన్న లేదా నివాస మరియు వాణిజ్య సంస్థల సంఖ్య సున్నా కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాల కోసం, అకారాది క్రమంలో క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడిన ULB RLB గ్రామాల పేర్లను జాబితా చేయండి.

src: Confirm the name of the state of Assam from the list of states that have recorded district information.
mt: असम राज्याचे नाव राज्यांच्या यादीतून नोंदविलेल्या जिल्हा माहितीच्या आधारे पुष्टी करा.

src: List the household IDs and their corresponding asset indices for Dalit households located in rural areas of Uttar Pradesh, ordered by their asset index.
mt:
या क्वेरीचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
उत्तर प्रदेशातील ग्रामीण भागातील दलित घरगुती कुटुंबांची घरगुती आयडी आणि त्यांचे संबंधित मालमत्ता निर्देशांक, त्यांच्या मालमत्ता निर्देशांकानुसार क्रमवारी लावून सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: Provide a list of household IDs for those categorized as OBC that have a recorded asset index, sorted by their ID.
mt: ओबीसी श्रेणीतील आणि नोंदणीकृत मालमत्ता निर्देशांक असलेल्या घरांची यादी त्यांच्या आयडीनुसार क्रमवारीत प्रदान करा.

src: List the names of the ULB, RLB, or villages located in the state of 'Andhra Pradesh' and the district of 'Chittoor', grouped and ordered alphabetically by the village name.
mt: 'आंध्र प्रदेश' राज्य आणि 'चित्तूर' जिल्ह्यातील शहरी स्थानिक संस्था, ग्रामीण स्थानिक संस्था किंवा गावांची नावे, गावाच्या नावानुसार वर्णक्रमानुसार गट करून सूचीबद्ध करा.

src: For the country of India and the census year 1991, list the districts and their calculated household density—defined as the sum of the number of households divided by the total population—for the top 10 districts with a total population greater than zero, ordered by density from highest to lowest.
mt: भारत देशासाठी आणि 1991 च्या जनगणना वर्षासाठी, एकूण लोकसंख्या शून्यापेक्षा जास्त असलेल्या जिल्ह्यांपैकी घनता (घरसंख्येची बेरीज एकूण लोकसंख्येने भागल्याने मिळणारी) नुसार सर्वोच्च ते सर्वात कमी अशा क्रमाने वरील 10 जिल्हे आणि त्यांची गणना केलेली घरसंख्या घनता यादी करा.

src: Compare the average monthly per capita consumption and total household count across different states and urban/rural areas, focusing only on households above the poverty line.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
गरीबी रेषेच्या वर असलेल्या घरांवर लक्ष केंद्रित करून, विविध राज्ये आणि शहरी/ग्रामीण भागातील सरासरी मासिक प्रति व्यक्ती उपभोग आणि एकूण कुटुंब संख्या यांची तुलना करा.

src: List the IDs of OBC households that have a high asset index and specific social network contacts, sorted from highest to lowest asset wealth.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
उच्च मालमत्ता निर्देशांक आणि विशिष्ट सामाजिक नेटवर्क संपर्क असलेल्या OBC कुटुंबांची ID यादी करा, जी सर्वोच्च ते निम्न मालमत्ता संपत्तीनुसार क्रमवारी लावलेली असेल.

src: List the driver ID, the age band of the driver, and the sex of the driver, along with the total count of accidents for each driver, specifically for those who have between 1-2 years of driving experience or whose educational level is 'Junior high school', including those with zero accidents, and order the results by the accident count in descending order.
mt: డ్రైవర్ ID, డ్రైవర్ యొక్క వయస్సు బ్యాండ్ మరియు డ్రైవర్ యొక్క లింగం, ప్రతి డ్రైవర్ కోసం మొత్తం ప్రమాదాల సంఖ్య, ప్రత్యేకంగా 1-2 సంవత్సరాల డ్రైవింగ్ అనుభవం ఉన్నవారు లేదా విద్యా స్థాయి 'జూనియర్ హైస్కూల్' ఉన్నవారు, సున్నా ప్రమాదాలు ఉన్నవారితో సహా, మరియు ఫలితాలను ప్రమాద సంఖ్య ఆధారంగా అవరోహణ క్రమంలో ఆర్డర్ చేయండి.

src: List the household ID, the household number, and the state code for all records where the household split number is greater than zero and the state code is 'Rajasthan'.
mt: కుటుంబ విభజన సంఖ్య (household split number) సున్నా కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండి మరియు రాష్ట్ర కోడ్ 'రాజస్థాన్' అని ఉన్న అన్ని రికార్డుల యొక్క హౌస్‌హోల్డ్ ఐడి (household ID), హౌస్‌హోల్డ్ నంబర్ (household number) మరియు రాష్ట్ర కోడ్ (state code) జాబితా చేయండి.

src: List the station names for stations located in the state of 'Andhra Pradesh' where the maximum fecal streptococci MPN per 100ml is greater than 1.
mt: 'Andhra Pradesh' राज्यात स्थित असलेल्या स्टेशनची नावे सूचीबद्ध करा जेथे जास्तीत जास्त मल स्ट्रेप्टोकोकी MPN प्रति 100ml 1 पेक्षा जास्त आहे.

src: List the sub-district names and the ULB/RLB village names where the total number of establishments owned by females is greater than the total number of establishments owned by males.
mt: उपजिल्ह्यांची नावे आणि त्या शहरी/ग्रामीण स्थानिक संस्था गावांची नावे यादी करा जिथे महिला मालकीच्या प्रतिष्ठानांची एकूण संख्या पुरुष मालकीच्या प्रतिष्ठानांच्या एकूण संख्येपेक्षा जास्त आहे.

src: Rank the states by their average rice yield in descending order, also showing the average wheat yield for each.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
सर्व राज्यांची सरासरी भात उत्पादनानुसार उतरत्या क्रमाने रँक करा, प्रत्येकाची सरासरी गहू उत्पादन देखील दर्शवा.

src: List the distinct light conditions for accidents where the number of casualties is greater than two and the day of the week is not Sunday, ordered alphabetically by the light conditions.
mt: वेळीस अपघातांसाठी वेगवेगळ्या प्रकाश परिस्थितीची यादी द्या जेथे मृतांची संख्या दोनपेक्षा जास्त आहे आणि आठवड्याचा दिवस रविवार नाही, प्रकाश परिस्थितीनुसार वर्णक्रमानुसार क्रमबद्ध केलेली.

src: Identify the states and districts that contain households either belonging to the Brahmin group or ranking 21 on the household assets index.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
ब्राह्मण गटातील किंवा घरगुती मालमत्ता निर्देशांकावर २१व्या क्रमांकावर असलेल्या घरांना ओळखणारे राज्ये आणि जिल्हे ओळखा.

src: List the household IDs and their corresponding caste or religious categories, ordered by their asset index.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
घरगुती आयडी आणि त्यांच्या संबंधित जात किंवा धार्मिक श्रेणी यांची यादी करा, त्यांच्या मालमत्तेच्या निर्देशांकानुसार क्रमवारी लावा.

src: For each activity status and education at migration code, what is the activity status, the education at migration code, and the total count of migrant IDs, including only those combinations with more than zero migrants, sorted by the count in descending order?
mt: ஒவ்வொரு செயல்பாட்டு நிலை (activity status) மற்றும் இடப்பெயர்வு குறியீட்டின் போதான கல்வித் தகுதிக்கும் (education at migration code), அந்தச் செயல்பாட்டு நிலை, இடப்பெயர்வு குறியீட்டின் போதான கல்வித் தகுதி மற்றும் புலம்பெயர்ந்தோர் ஐடிகளின் (migrant IDs) மொத்த எண்ணிக்கை என்ன? இதில் பூஜ்ஜியத்திற்கும் அதிகமான புலம்பெயர்ந்தோரைக் கொண்ட சேர்க்கைகளை மட்டும் சேர்த்து, எண்ணிக்கையின் அடிப்படையில் இறங்கு வரிசையில் வரிசைப்படுத்தவும்.

src: List the IDs of households belonging to the OBC category that have a primary social network contact, sorted numerically.
mt: OBC श्रेणीतील घरांना प्राथमिक सामाजिक नेटवर्क संपर्क असलेल्या घरांची ID यादी करा, संख्यानुसार क्रमवारी लावा.

src: For the census year 2013, list the sub-district names and the ULB/RLB village names along with the total sum of establishments owned by Sikhs, grouped by sub-district and village name and ordered by the sum in descending order.
mt: सन २०१३ च्या जनगणनेसाठी, उपजिल्हा नावे आणि यूएलबी/आरएलबी गाव नावे यांच्यासह सिख समुदायाच्या मालकीच्या स्थापनांची एकूण बेरीज, उपजिल्हा आणि गाव नावानुसार गट करून आणि बेरीज उतरत्या क्रमाने क्रमवारी लावा.

src: List the household IDs for households where every member is at least 46 years old, specifically filtering for households that do not contain any individuals with a marital status code of 'Married'.
mt: अशा कुटुंबांचे आयडी (IDs) सूचीबद्ध करा ज्यामधील प्रत्येक सदस्याचे वय किमान ४६ वर्षे आहे, आणि विशेषतः अशी कुटुंबे निवडा ज्यामध्ये 'विवाहित' (Married) वैवाहिक स्थिती असलेला एकही सदस्य नाही.

src: Provide the production and yield statistics for chickpeas and pigeon peas in Chhattisgarh for the year 1970.
mt: छत्तीसगढमध्ये १९७० साली चणा आणि तूर यांच्या उत्पादन आणि उत्पादनाच्या आकडेवारीची माहिती द्या.

src: List the districts in Chhattisgarh that produced exactly 200 tons of finger millet and at least some pearl millet during the year 1970, sorted alphabetically.
mt: छत्तीसगढमधील जिल्हे सूचीबद्ध करा ज्यांनी १९७० या वर्षात नक्की ५०० टन नाचणी आणि किमान काही बाजरी उत्पादन केले होते, वर्णक्रमानुसार क्रमवारी लावा.

src: List the top 10 district codes with the highest number of records, specifically for households where the new household split number is greater than zero, grouped by their district code.
mt: புதிய வீட்டுக் கிளை எண் (household split number) பூஜ்ஜியத்தை விட அதிகமாக உள்ள வீடுகளின் தரவுகளை மட்டும் கணக்கில் கொண்டு, மாவட்ட வாரியாக அதிக எண்ணிக்கையிலான பதிவுகளைக் கொண்ட முதல் 10 மாவட்டக் குறியீடுகளைப் பட்டியலிடவும்.

src: Provide a breakdown of the total number of children over 10 and 16 years old who received immunizations in 2021, categorized by sub-district and area type.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
२०२१ मध्ये लसीकरण घेतलेल्या १० आणि १६ वर्षांपेक्षा जास्त वयाच्या मुलांची एकूण संख्या उप-जिल्हा आणि क्षेत्र प्रकारानुसार वर्गीकृत करून सादर करा.

src: Provide a breakdown by state and urban/rural classification of the average monthly per capita consumption and non-food expenditures.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
राज्य आणि शहरी/ग्रामीण वर्गीकरणानुसार सरासरी मासिक प्रति व्यक्ती उपभोग आणि अन्नेतर खर्चाचे विभाजन प्रदान करा.

src: Identify the sub-districts that recorded allopathic outpatient attendance in 2022 but had no such attendance in 2021.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
२०२२ मध्ये अॅलोपॅथिक आउटपेशंट उपस्थिती नोंदवलेल्या पण २०२१ मध्ये अशी कोणतीही उपस्थिती नसलेल्या उपजिल्ह्यांची ओळख करा.

src: List the casualty IDs for casualties classified as pedestrians where the fitness of the casualty is normal, grouped by their casualty ID.
mt: కాలుబాటపై నడిచే వ్యక్తులుగా వర్గీకరించిన ఆపద IDs ను జాబితా చేయండి, ఇక్కడ ఆపద యొక్క ఫిట్‌నెస్ సాధారణమైనది, వారి ఆపద ID ద్వారా సమూహీకరించబడింది.

src: List each district name along with the total sum of agricultural credit societies and other credit societies, ensuring the sum is greater than zero and sorted in descending order by that total.
mt: प्रत्येक जिल्ह्याचे नाव आणि त्यातील कृषी पतसंस्था व इतर पतसंस्थांची एकूण बेरीज यांची यादी द्या, ही बेरीज शून्यापेक्षा जास्त असावी आणि एकूण बेरजेनुसार उतरत्या क्रमाने लावली असावी.

src: Show all columns from the casualty dimension for records where the casualty class is 'Pedestrian' and the fitness of the casualty is 'Normal'.
mt: जिथे जखमी वर्ग 'पादचारी' आहे आणि जखमीची फिटनेस 'सामान्य' आहे अशा रेकॉर्डसाठी जखमी परिमाणातून सर्व स्तंभ दाखवा.

src: List the sub-district name and the census year, along with the sum of total establishments and the sum of residential-commercial establishments, grouped by both sub-district and census year, and ordered chronologically by the census year.
mt: उप-जिल्हाचे नाव आणि जनगणना वर्ष, एकत्रित स्थापनांची बेरीज आणि निवासी-व्यावसायिक स्थापनांची बेरीज, उप-जिल्हा आणि जनगणना वर्ष या दोन्हीनुसार गट करून, आणि जनगणना वर्षानुसार कालानुक्रमानुसार क्रमवारीत लावा.

src: Identify households with an asset index of 27 and a specific type of social network contact, ranked by their total monthly consumption expenditure.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
२७ च्या मालमत्ता निर्देशांक असलेले आणि विशिष्ट प्रकारच्या सामाजिक संपर्क जाळ्याचे संपर्क असलेले घरगुती ओळखा, त्यांच्या एकूण मासिक उपभोग खर्चानुसार क्रमवारी लावा.

src: Provide the average social ID for households with children not currently enrolled in school, broken down by their caste/religion category and asset index.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
शाळेत सध्या नोंदणीकृत नसलेल्या मुलांच्या कुटुंबांसाठी सरासरी सामाजिक आयडी, त्यांच्या जात/धर्म श्रेणी आणि मालमत्ता निर्देशांकानुसार विभागून प्रदान करा.

src: For the census year 2013, list the sub-district names and the total sum of estimated education and human health and social services, ordered by this combined sum in descending order for the top 5 sub-districts.
mt: 2013 च्या जनगणना वर्षासाठी, उप-जिल्ह्यांची नावे आणि अंदाजे शिक्षण आणि मानवी आरोग्य व सामाजिक सेवा यांची एकूण बेरीज, या एकूण बेरीजीच्या उतरत्या क्रमाने शीर्ष 5 उप-जिल्ह्यांसाठी यादी करा.

src: List the migrant ID, the education at migration code, and the marital status at migration code for all individuals whose marital status at migration code is 'Married'.
mt: ज्या व्यक्तींची स्थलांतराच्या वेळची वैवाहिक स्थिती 'विवाहित' (Married) आहे, अशा सर्व व्यक्तींचा स्थलांतरित आयडी (migrant ID), स्थलांतराच्या वेळचा शिक्षण कोड (education at migration code) आणि स्थलांतराच्या वेळचा वैवाहिक स्थिती कोड (marital status at migration code) यांची यादी करा.

src: List the sub-district names located in the district with ID 1 where the total sum of agricultural credit societies is equal to 0.000.
mt: जिल्हा आयडी (ID) १ मध्ये असलेल्या अशा उप-जिल्ह्यांच्या नावांची यादी करा जिथे कृषी पत संस्थांची एकूण बेरीज ०.००० आहे.

src: Identify the rural sub-districts that reported at least one first dose of the Rotavirus vaccine but zero first doses of Vitamin A in 2020, listed alphabetically.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
२०२० मध्ये रोटाव्हायरस लसीची किमान एक पहिली डोस नोंदवलेली परंतु व्हिटॅमिन ए ची शून्य पहिली डोस नोंदवलेली ग्रामीण उपजिल्हे ओळखा, त्यांची वर्णक्रमानुसार यादी द्या.

src: Provide a breakdown of the average household size and the average number of married women per household, categorized by religious or caste groups, urban-rural status, and state.
mt:
या प्रश्नाचे भाषांतर करा:
सरासरी घरगुती आकार आणि सरासरी लग्न झालेल्या महिलांची संख्या प्रति घरगुती, धार्मिक किंवा जातीय गट, शहरी-ग्रामीण स्थिती आणि राज्यानुसार वर्गीकृत करून विभाजन प्रदान करा.

src: For each person ID, count the number of migrant IDs and display the person ID for those who were not married when they migrated, grouped and ordered by their person ID.
mt: प्रत्येक व्यक्ती आयडीसाठी (person ID), स्थलांतरित आयडींची (migrant ID) संख्या मोजा आणि ज्या व्यक्तींनी अविवाहित असताना स्थलांतर केले आहे अशा व्यक्तींचे आयडी प्रदर्शित करा, तसेच हे सर्व त्यांच्या व्यक्ती आयडीनुसार गटबद्ध (grouped) आणि क्रमाने (ordered) लावा.

src: For the state of Maharashtra, list the PSU codes in ascending order for all locations where the completion status is 'Located', provided that there is at least one household with a split number equal to zero.
mt: महाराष्ट्र राज्यासाठी, ज्या ठिकाणांची पूर्णता स्थिती (completion status) 'Located' आहे आणि जिथे किमान एका कुटुंबाचा स्प्लिट नंबर (split number) शून्य आहे, अशा सर्व ठिकाणांच्या PSU कोडची चढत्या क्रमाने यादी करा.

src: For male drivers in the age bands of '31-50' or '18-30', list their educational level and driving experience along with the average number of casualties per accident, specifically for those groups with more than one accident, and order the results by the average casualty count in descending order.
mt: '31-50' किंवा '18-30' वयोगटातील पुरुष चालकांसाठी, त्यांचे शैक्षणिक स्तर आणि ड्रायव्हिंग अनुभव एक अपघातापेक्षा जास्त असलेल्या गटांसाठी प्रति अपघात सरासरी मृत्यूदंड संख्येसह सूचीबद्ध करा, आणि परिणाम सरासरी मृत्यूदंड संख्येनुसार उतरत्या क्रमाने क्रमांकित करा.

src: For the state of Maharashtra, list the PSU codes in ascending order for all locations where the completion status is 'Located', provided that there is at least one household with a split number equal to zero.
mt: মহারাষ্ট্র রাজ্যের জন্য, সেই সমস্ত অবস্থানের PSU কোডগুলি আরোহী ক্রমে (ascending order) তালিকাভুক্ত করুন যেখানে সমাপ্তির স্থিতি (completion status) 'Located' এবং যেখানে অন্তত একটি এমন পরিবার রয়েছে যার স্প্লিট নম্বর (split number) শূন্যের সমান।

src: List the unique PSU codes in ascending order for households where the completion status is 'Located', the household split number is 0, and the new household split number is 1.
mt: সেইসব খানা বা পরিবারের জন্য অনন্য (unique) পিএসইউ (PSU) কোডগুলো আরোহী ক্রমে (ascending order) তালিকাভুক্ত করুন, যেখানে সমাপ্তির স্থিতি (completion status) 'Located', খানার বিভাজন নম্বর (household split number) ০ এবং নতুন খানার বিভাজন নম্বর (new household split number) ১।

src: Identify the sub-districts that recorded allopathic outpatient attendance in 2022 but had no such attendance reported in 2021.
mt:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
2022 में आयुर्विज्ञान आउटपेशेंट उपस्थिति दर्ज करने वाले उप-जिलों की पहचान करें, लेकिन 2021 में ऐसी उपस्थिति दर्ज नहीं की गई थी।

src: List the household ID, the household number, and the same address indicator for all records where the new household split number is equal to 1.
mt: ज्या सर्व नोंदींमध्ये नवीन कुटुंब विभाजन क्रमांक (new household split number) १ आहे, त्या सर्व नोंदींसाठी कुटुंबाचा आयडी (household ID), कुटुंब क्रमांक (household number) आणि समान पत्ता निर्देशक (same address indicator) यांची यादी करा.

src: For each state ID, provide the state ID and the total count of sub-district names associated with it.
mt: प्रत्येक राज्य आयडीसाठी (state ID), राज्य आयडी आणि त्याच्याशी संबंधित उप-जिल्ह्यांच्या नावांची एकूण संख्या द्या.

src: For accidents that occurred on a Monday, list each area where an accident occurred, the average number of casualties per accident in that area, and the total count of accident IDs, ensuring only areas with at least one accident are shown and ordering the results by the average number of casualties from highest to lowest.
mt: सोमवारी घडलेल्या अपघातांसाठी, प्रत्येक क्षेत्र जेथे अपघात घडला तेथे सूचीबद्ध करा, त्या क्षेत्रातील प्रति अपघात सरासरी जखमींची संख्या, आणि अपघात आयडीची एकूण संख्या, केवळ कमीतकमी एक अपघात असलेले क्षेत्र दर्शविल्या जात आहेत आणि परिणाम सरासरी जखमींची संख्या सर्वोच्च ते सर्वनिम्न क्रमाने क्रमबद्ध करा.

src: Identify the household IDs and corresponding village or neighborhood codes for rural households in Rajasthan that have more than two married women.
mt:
हा प्रश्न भाषांतरित करा:
राजस्थानातील ग्रामीण घरांसाठी, ज्यामध्ये दोनपेक्षा जास्त विवाहित महिला आहेत, त्यांचे घरगुती आयडी आणि संबंधित गाव किंवा शेजार कोड ओळखा.

src: Provide the annual total for allopathic outpatient attendance across all recorded years.
mt: सर्व नोंदवलेल्या वर्षांमध्ये ऍलोपॅथिक आउटपेशंट उपस्थितीचे वार्षिक एकूण प्रदान करा.

src: List the names of the ULB, RLB, or villages where the estimated transport and storage value is greater than 50 or the estimated accommodation and food services value is greater than 50, ordered alphabetically by the village name.
